title: senecio cacaliiformis
intro: Senecio cacaliiformis, commonly known as the 'Ragwort', is a perennial plant native to New Zealand, known for its yellow, daisy-like flowers. The health benefits of Senecio cacaliiformis include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Senecio cacaliiformis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
